integrity: The proof covers every finite admissible size. Standard-library enumeration through population size 11 passed 6527 exact checks; finite checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-size samples from consecutive integer populations only. The normalized-gap convex order uses the standard unit-reinforcement urn representation; no assertion of novelty for the classical urn/composition identities. A closely relevant 2001 paper on without-replacement spacings was inspected and credited; its first-public day was not verified, so the recorded date identifies the earliest day-verified selected method source, not an asserted date for that earlier work. Historical priority remains qualified. No independent audit.
title: Dual stochastic orders for span-conditioned gaps in a uniform finite sample
